title: The Five Steps All Leaders Must Take in the Age of Uncertainty
summary: The article identifies five critical leadership practices required to navigate contemporary organizational uncertainty. These practices address how leaders must rethink their approach to strategy, decision-making, and team management in volatile conditions. The framework positions leadership adaptation as essential rather than optional in periods of systemic change.
central_argument: Leaders must adopt five specific practices to maintain organizational effectiveness when operating under fundamental uncertainty rather than calculable risk.
